guidelines: official recommendations on how something should be done
The clinic follows strict guidelines on how vaccines must be stored.
leading: most important or most successful in a particular field
She works for one of the leading hospitals in the country.
organization: a group of people organized for a particular purpose
The charity is a nonprofit organization that supports rural schools.
expects: The body is asked to be alert when its clock expects sleep.
release: to set something or someone free
The zookeepers plan to release the rescued birds back into the wild.
later: at a time after the one mentioned
They met again later that year at a conference.
year: Everyone agrees the device runs for only a handful of minutes a year.
